DiscoveryIndex.target.cfg.ref: Index-contract review A2: evidence armed before the first read, own writes tapped before they are issued and when they settle, reads installed under the directory's evidence counter, which no install lowers. 2 directories, 2 readers per directory, 2 changes, 1 own write, 1 repeated fact, no lost fact.

DiscoveryIndex.target-lost.cfg.ref: A2 and A4: one fact lost and the audit on, 2 readers per directory. CleanIsCurrent holds outside the lost directory, and EventuallyCurrent under LiveSpec (weak fairness of arming, delivery, the reads and the audit). Quiescence: Quiescent. 2 directories, 1 change, 1 lost change; no own write or repeated fact, which target covers, so the family stays within the pr budget.

DiscoveryIndex.clear-unconditional.cfg.ref: Index-contract review F5, A2(f): a read that clears its directory unconditionally loses the fact that arrived while it ran. 1 change.

DiscoveryIndex.read-before-arm.cfg.ref: Index-contract review F4, A2(e), A3: the first read runs before the observer, the notice subscription or the poll baseline is in place, so a change between them is in no fact. 1 change.

DiscoveryIndex.tap-after-write.cfg.ref: Index-contract review F2, A2(a): own writes heard only when they settle, as the change bus reports them, leave the directory clean while its bytes have changed. 1 own write.

DiscoveryIndex.no-audit.cfg.ref: Index-contract review F3, A4: a lost fact with no audit is never repaired; the audit is load-bearing. 1 lost change, audit off.

DiscoveryIndex.reset-on-install.cfg.ref: FW2 review M1: with two readers of one directory, an install that resets the directory's counter to its floor lets a slower reader that captured the floor install older bytes as clean after a faster reader installed newer ones. 1 change, no own write.

DiscoveryIndex.target-lost-wide.cfg.ref: target-lost with the own write and the repeated fact back in (2 directories, 2 readers per directory, 1 change, 1 lost change, 1 own write, 1 repeated fact): CleanIsCurrent and EventuallyCurrent under LiveSpec.
